puzzle.body: Enabled test for `ApiRepoUpdateSlice`. Now test for `ApiRepoUpdateSlice` is disabled because yaml string that passes with NameValuePair does not have enough spaces and does not have break lines at all. For example, instead of `repo:\n type:docker\n storage:path` the value `repo: type:docker storage:path` is got therefore NPE is occurred. So, it is necessary to fix this problem and enable test after that.
